Counsel for Applicant :- Wahid Jamal Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant; learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Mona @ Mohit, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 134 of 2023, under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Binauli,
District- Baghpat, during pendency of trial.
There are allegations against the applicant of committing the offence of rape against a minor girl.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has falsely been implicated in this case.

sentences.text: Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

This Court, after hearing the learned counsels for the parties, does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage since medical report of the victim fully supports the prosecution case.
The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.

The trial court is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant, as expeditiously as possible, as per Section 346 B.N.S.S./309 Cr.P.C.
Order Date :- 30.5.2025
